title: Spectral freeze recall and source stages ahead of the spectral mask

needles: SpectralMaskProcessor applies the live mask after a held pre-mask source
SpectralMaskProcessor wet-source stage feeds the wet path only
FreezeHold re-freeze after release holds only post-release frames
FreezeHold snapshot restores the same held output

installed_sdk.rationale: Pulp::signal installs both headers. SpectralMaskProcessor accepts non-owning time-domain wet-source and frame-domain pre-mask stages, and FreezeHold adds the fresh-capture release rule, clear_history, seconds-based timing with a runtime hold length, the held-state pipeline, and snapshot/stage_restore recall. All are in-process audio-owner primitives with allocation-free audio paths.

offline_timeline_cli.rationale: Freeze and mask source stages are streaming audio-owner primitives composed inside a processor; they add no offline Timeline command.

offline_timeline_mcp.rationale: The primitives are consumed by processors and add no MCP operation.

live_product_control.rationale: No Product A control surface is added; a product exposes its own Freeze and hold-length parameters and drives these primitives from its audio thread.

design_time_agent_manifest.rationale: The installed capability manifest describes signal.spectral-mask-processor with its optional source stages; freeze_hold.hpp is recorded in the public-surface ledger as reviewed infrastructure with no capability key of its own.
